about: Top-down battle maps (OpenAI image generation through Codex CLI), each drawn over its fight grid and cut to it; originals in ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/.

maps.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as winter-caravan--smoke-junction.png in the current directory.

A tabletop battle map, landscape 3:2, seen straight from above (orthographic top-down), of this place: «Дымный Разъезд» — Три дома, амбар и навес на южном берегу, у каменного брода. Река подо льдом шумит у северного берега. Хозяин Ошвен Иль продаёт мешки и дрова и пускает под крышу.

The first reference image is the exact layout of the playable field: a 18 by 14 square grid drawn in the middle of the canvas. Keep the same composition and positions: every dark or black square is a solid obstacle that blocks movement or gives full cover, every mid-grey square is a low obstacle that gives partial cover, every square with diagonal hatching is difficult ground. Choose obstacles that belong to this place (for example crates, pillars, rocks, machinery, furniture, rigging) and draw them exactly on those squares, at the scale of one square each. Plain light squares are open floor or ground the figures walk on. The flat grey area outside the grid is the same place continuing beyond the field: fill it with matching terrain of lesser importance, no key features there.

What this field is, in the campaign's own words (Russian; use it to decide what each kind of square looks like, e.g. hatched squares may be water, rubble, a gap between roofs or a drop, not just rough floor): Поле 18 × 14: столбцы A–R с запада, ряд 1 — северный край. Река течёт с востока на запад, брод пересекает её с севера на юг: обоз идёт с северного берега к Разъезду на южном. Ряды 1–3 — северный берег: снег у ив, у воды две каменные плиты брода (I3, J3) — укрытие наполовину. Наискось через середину, от H1 к D12, тянется гряда брода: торосы и наметённый снег на плитах (труднопроходимые клетки); плита посреди реки в G6 — укрытие наполовину. Скопление K11–M13 у южного берега — тонкий лёд над быстриной (труднопроходимо, мул проваливается по колено). Остальное — гладкий лёд. Мулы стоят на гряде в G–I, ряды 6–9; отряд — у западного края (A–C), ниже по течению, и бежит к мулам наперегонки со стаей, которая выходит с восточного (P–R).

Match one consistent house style: original premium illustrated winter mountain survival for players aged 16 and over, painterly oil and gouache with confident ink lines and crisp readable silhouettes; the Frost Spine, a fictional northern range of cedar and fir valleys climbing to bare rock ribs and wind-scoured snowfields under a short winter day; a caravan of four heavy cargo sledges under pale cream felt tents, drawn by frost-rimed mules in rope harness; textures of crusted snow, hoarfrost on traces, beards and eyelashes, felted wool, tarred hemp rope, birch bark and woodsmoke; palette of snow white and blue-grey shadow, slate and granite grey, deep fir green, felt cream, mule brown and the small warm amber and ember orange of campfires and lanterns; hard cold, wind and silence set against the warmth of small fires and tired people sharing what little they have; every person shown is clearly an adult. Papers, tallies and notches carry only blank or illegible marks. No gore, no wounds, no blood, no anatomy, no injured or suffering animals, no weapons pointed at the viewer, no franchise references, no anime look, no photorealism. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border.

Мешки и вязанки лежат на дне у обломков саней, в I–L.
